dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Whoa! This orchard smells wonderful! The apples must be super big and juicy!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And these bunches of grapes weighing down the dense vines... *sigh* They'll become delicious wine one day...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why don't we... sample some of these future wines? Hehe, it can't hurt to enjoy them a little. Come on, open wide~
